name: Phase 2 — Auth: Devise + Pundit with admin/user roles
objective: Add Devise authentication and Pundit authorization. User model with admin boolean flag. Basic sign-up/sign-in/sign-out flows with Tailwind-styled views.
exit_criteria: Devise sign up, sign in, sign out flows work
All Devise views styled with Tailwind
Root redirects to sign_in for unauthenticated users
Admin flag testable via rails console
